build_GPT2Tokenizer_from_pretrained: build a GPT2Tokenizer from pretrained model name or path using from_pretrained class method
create_GPT2Tokenizer_tokenize: create a list of BPE tokens from a text string using the tokenize method
test_GPT2Tokenizer_encode_decode: test encoding text to token IDs and decoding token IDs back to text
refactor_GPT2Tokenizer_bpe: refactor the BPE tokenization algorithm to merge symbol pairs based on learned ranks
review_GPT2Tokenizer_save_vocabulary: review the save_vocabulary method that writes vocab, merges, and special tokens files to disk
